text:
Maya R: quick thread to capture postmortem follow-ups from the regional failover postmortem. i pulled all action items into this thread so we can track ownership and unblock the next DR rehearsal.

Jon T: tl;dr from infra: during the failover exercise routing favored the origin region because health-checks flapped when control-plane api latency spiked. need stronger fallback logic.

Eve L: backup note: some snapshots were missing the 'replicated' tag in eu regions. restore attempts failed because runbook assumed cross-region replication.

SRE-Bot: incident created: INC-2024-4523 (regional-failover-test). link: https://incidents.redwood.dev/INC-2024-4523

Sam (Oncall): I'm coordinating the remediation sprint board. please ack your items below and add PR/board links when ready. i'll do weekly gating until closed.

Maya R: ACTION-A: router fallback policy: when control-plane latency > 500ms for 2m, prefer warm-standby region using per-az healthy-sockets metric. Owner: Jon T. Due: 2024-05-15. Deliverable: PR + integration test in routing-sim.

Jon T: ack. will implement policy and add unit + integration tests. planning canary run on 2024-05-18.

Maya R: ACTION-B: runbook restore-step: add preflight verification to confirm snapshot replication and integrity checksum. Owner: Eve L. Due: 2024-04-26.

Eve L: ack. will add verification command and failure semantics (abort vs retry). snippet I'll add: ```bash
aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:service,Values=redwood Name=tag:replicated,Values=true
```

Maya R: ACTION-C: backup policy inventory and normalization. Owner: Eve L (+SRE help). Task: produce CSV with region, service, retention-days, last-backup. Due: 2024-05-02. Standard: critical-state=90d.

Eve L: starting inventory today, will push results to DR project board and open tickets for outliers. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/412/backup-inventory-report (WIP)

Maya R: ACTION-D: priming/kv-cache job should fail noisily on auth errors and create a short-lived retry queue. Owner: Jon T. Due: 2024-04-29. Alert: alert if priming_auth_errors_total > 1 for 10m.

Jon T: implemented auth-check patch locally, raising PR shortly. alert rule will be prometheus:sum(rate(priming_auth_errors_total[10m])) > 0

Sam (Oncall): ACTION-E: weekly closure reminders + DR board owners sync. Owner: Sam. Due: recurring weekly starting 2024-04-22. I'll attach checklist template.

Maya R: ACTION-F: tabletop run prep: 30-min pre-game to walk through contacts, failure modes, and the updated runbook. Owner: Maya R. Due: 2024-05-10.

Jon T: planning note: observed recurring pattern where k8s leader election + control-plane latency -> inconsistent routing decisions. recommend small runbook section: "leader-flip heuristic" and a fallback metric. ACTION-G: add leader-flip guidance to runbook. Owner: Jon T. Due: 2024-05-01.

Eve L: also noticed credential rotation window isn't documented in the priming job. we should add a rolling credential expiry check to CI. ACTION-H: add credential-expiry e2e to daily tests. Owner: Eve L. Due: 2024-05-06.

Maya R: coordination note: please keep PRs < 200 LOC and include a one-line test plan so we can merge fast during the sprint.

SRE-Bot: deploy note: routing-sim v0.4 deployed to staging at 2024-04-21T09:12:00Z

Sam (Oncall): I'll create tasks on the DR board and post links here. also adding a column for 'blocking infra' so we can tag infra owners.

Jon T: small risk: changing fallback rules could route more traffic to warm-standby under partial outages, we should add cost metric in canary. ACTION-I: add canary cost/latency dashboard for 2-hour game day. Owner: Jon T. Due: 2024-05-16.

Eve L: PRs: https://git.redwood.dev/r/412/backup-inventory-report, https://git.redwood.dev/r/419/runbook-restore-checks (WIP)

Maya R: scheduling: propose DR rehearsal (2h) on 2024-05-19 to validate routing fallback, snapshot checks, and priming requeue. ACTION-J: confirm attendees and runbook owner for rehearsal. Owner: Sam. Due: 2024-05-05.

Sam (Oncall): will confirm invites and calendar. sending Doodle today.

Maya R: last ask: flag any ETA slips > 3d in-thread so we can triage scope. we'll review at next postmortem follow-up meeting.

Jon T: no blockers from infra team atm.

Eve L: no blockers.

Sam (Oncall): closing thread for now. i'll post DR board links and weekly reminders. :calendar:
